risks: Gemini credit gauge instability (failed twice with rc 77 on 2026-10-19) can stall S0/S5 seats if automatic fallback to Sol 6.1 and Opus 5.5 is not pre-wired.

Host /dev/vhost-vsock access was previously recorded as denied under unprivileged operational identity while /dev/kvm was permitted; nested microVMs inside Docker must support user-space virtio-vsock over UDS or virtio-serial without silently requesting root or weakening capsule isolation.

Aggregating N containers x M microVMs with per-attempt /dev/shm workspaces and optional xpra frame buffers can exhaust the 96 GiB newton-ia.slice memory ceiling or trigger Linux OOM-kills if VMM process overhead and tmpfs ceilings are not reserved up front with swap strictly disabled.

Local per-commit <repo>@<sha> image builds on the GB10 host violate campaign governance if triggered by auto_sync/auto_ingest without a recorded operator approval policy, and risk leaking host ~/.config or credentials if build contexts are not hermetically staged.

Unthrottled OpenSwitchboard conference rooms can suffer message storms, cross-worker prompt injection, or prefix-cache invalidation (violating INV-C01 PIN-01) if room digests leak into Z1/Z2 or if vigia-enjambre does not enforce hard per-pulse rate and rune clamps.

Web Bridge auto_ingest parser compatibility with os.cu.worker-receipt/v1 and deduplicated wave finding graphs is not yet proven in the bound repository files and requires a strict phase-1 parity gate before live wave collection.
